---
title: Logo without alt text
brand: _brand.yml
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A user brand logo with no alt text warns and names the file.
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'mcanouil: the logo "figure\.svg" has no alt text\. Add alt to the logo in _brand\.yml\.'
        count: 1
---
